default_exit._why: one exit for every family so rules compete on the same footing; the owner will decide the demo stop/take-profit later and this block changes then (a change = a new screen run, its variants counted again)
default_exit._fills: signal at the close of bar t; market order at the open of the 1-minute bar that starts at t's close (+ slippage); every 1-minute bar from the entry minute on: stop first (fills at the stop or the gap open, - slippage), then the target (a limit: needs a trade 1 tick through, fills at the target); time exit at the open of the first minute at or after entry + max_hold_min; flat at the session's flatten time; one position at a time; at most max_entries_per_session entries per session

E-1248.title: Seasonal same-minute forward drift
E-1248.hypothesis: Intraday flows (opening hedges, lunch, US open, closing auction) recur at the same clock minute; if the last 20 sessions' average forward return from this minute is large relative to its typical size, the same flow should recur: trade in that direction.

E-1249.title: Autocorrelation-regime bar follow/fade
E-1249.hypothesis: When recent bar returns show positive lag-1 autocorrelation, participants are chasing and a large bar is followed; when negative, liquidity providers dominate and a large bar is faded.

E-1250.title: Absorption bar at a rolling extreme
E-1250.hypothesis: A heavy-volume bar with a small range at a rolling high/low means aggressive orders were absorbed by passive liquidity; the aggressor is trapped, so fade.

E-1251.title: Session-max volume bar with extreme close
E-1251.hypothesis: The largest volume bar of the session closing near its high or low shows a decisive aggressor with no immediate rejection; follow it.

E-1252.title: Volatility expansion bar follow
E-1252.hypothesis: When short-term range jumps relative to the longer average, a new information flow has arrived; the direction of the expansion bar is followed.

E-1253.title: Day-range traversal
E-1253.hypothesis: On a day with a wide range, price travelling from one end of the session range to its middle within a short time shows the other side has been overwhelmed; follow the traversal.

E-1254.title: Late-session VWAP cross
E-1254.hypothesis: Late in the session, institutional benchmark traders chase the VWAP; a cross of the VWAP in the last hours drags price toward the close in that direction.

E-1255.title: EMA deviation z-score fade
E-1255.hypothesis: A close stretched several standard deviations from its short EMA, measured against its own recent deviations, is an overshoot by impatient flow; fade back toward the mean.

E-1256.title: Impulse bar confirmation hold
E-1256.hypothesis: A strong closing bar followed by a smaller bar that holds above its midpoint and closes in the same direction shows buyers/sellers accepted the move; follow.

E-1257.title: Rolling close-rank extreme fade
E-1257.hypothesis: A close that ranks at the very top (bottom) of the closes of the last hour is an extension of short-term supply/demand; fade it as it mean-reverts.
